<r=プライマル・ベルト>原生帯</r>のメイズシフターは強いって話だったけど、: People said the Maze Shifters in the Primal Belt were strong, but that wasn't really a problem at all.
そうですか？\n私は結構厳しかったなって思うんですけど……: Is that so? I thought it was pretty tough myself...
弾薬を気にしながらの戦闘は難しい……: Fighting while having to constantly worry about ammo is difficult...
それにしては効率的に倒してたようだったけど？: Even so, you guys seemed to take them down pretty efficiently though?
的確に撃破してくださっていましたわね。\nとても頼りになりましたわ。: You defeated them so precisely. You were all very reliable.
それは……運がよかっただけだから。: That was... just pure good luck.
たとえ運のおかげだったとしても、\n弾薬の浪費をしないで済んだのは事実なんだ。: Even if luck played a part, it's a fact that we managed to avoid wasting ammo.
もしあの戦闘で弾薬とエネルギーを使いすぎていたら、\n撤退するしかなかったんだか: If we had used up too much ammo and energy in that fight, we would have had no choice but to retreat.
私達を模擬戦で倒したんだから、\nあのぐらいの敵は余裕で勝ってもらわないと困るわ: Since you defeated us in a mock battle, it would be troublesome if you couldn't defeat enemies of that level with ease.
……さて、それじゃあ、先へ進みましょうか。: ...Now then, shall we keep moving forward?
おっ、もしかして、お待ちかねの『お楽しみタイム』かな？: Oh, could this be the long-awaited 'fun time'?
ええ、メイズシフターが巣に貯め込んだタツミヤ鉱を、\nいただきに行くわ。: Yes, we're going to collect the Tatsumiya Ore that the Maze Shifters have hoarded in their nest.
やったー！ もう、ほんと待ちかねたんだから！\n原生帯〈プライマル・ベルト〉初の: Hooray! Man, I've really been waiting for this! Our very first Tatsumiya Ore in the Primal Belt♪ Hehe.
でも地穴帯〈ケイブ・ベルト〉と違って危険度は格段に上がるわ。\nだから警戒は忘れ: However, unlike the Cave Belt, the danger level goes up significantly. So make sure not to drop your guard.
斥候役をローテーションで変えながら\n慎重にルートを選んで先へ進んでいく。: We rotated the scouting duties while carefully choosing our route as we pressed forward.
そ、そろそろ巣がある場所ですから、\n今まで以上に警戒をしてくださいね……: W-We're getting close to where the nest is, so please be even more vigilant than before...
気緩みすぎ。: You're slacking off way too much.
あたしとしてはぜひタマゴとかあれば、持ち帰りたいな♪: As for me, if there are any eggs, I'd definitely love to bring one back♪
間違っても寮の冷蔵庫に入れるんじゃないぞ。: Don't you dare put it in the dorm fridge, under any circumstances.
いや、デカすぎて入んないでしょ！？: Hey, it's gonna be way too big to fit in there anyway, right!?
斥候に出ていた七彩の報告に全員が反応する。\nバラバラに散って遮蔽物の陰に機体を: Everyone reacted to the report from Nanairo, who had been out scouting. We scattered and hid our units behind cover.
そして、件のメイズシフターの通過を待っていると――: And then, as we waited for the Maze Shifter in question to pass by—
あんなの……どうしたらいいんですか……: Something like that... what are we supposed to do against that...
そこには横坑〈ドリフト〉の天井に届くのではないかと思えるほど、\n超巨大なメイズ: There stood a super-gargantuan Maze Shifter, raising its head so high it almost looked like it could reach the ceiling of the Drift.
（シルエットだけでいうなら、超巨大な竜脚類の恐竜か……\nでも体毛もあって……こ: (If I had to judge by its silhouette alone, it looks like a gigantic sauropod dinosaur... but it has body fur too... To think something like this actually exists...)
巨大過ぎて頭の動きがスローモーションのようにも見える。: Because it was so enormous, the movements of its head almost looked like slow motion.
全機、極静音モードに切り替えなさい。\n可能な限り気配を消してやり過ごすしかない: All units, switch to ultra-silent mode. Our only option is to erase our presence as much as possible and let it pass.
舞亜の指示に従って機体のエネルギー出力を絞り、\nセンサー類も最低限に抑える。: Following Maia's instructions, we dialed back our units' power output and suppressed all sensors to the bare minimum.
意味はないとわかりつつコクピットの中で息を殺す。\n自分の心臓の音がいつもより大: Even knowing it was useless, I held my breath inside the cockpit. My own heartbeat sounded louder than usual.
この音があのメイズシフターに聞こえてしまうのではないか。\nそんなありえない考え: Could that Maze Shifter actually hear this sound? I shook off the impossible thought.
超巨大メイズシフターが一歩を踏み出すたびに\n地面が大きく揺れる。: Every time the super-gargantuan Maze Shifter took a step, the ground shook violently.
振動に巨木が揺れ、機体の表面を枝が叩く。\nその音に気が付かないでくれと心の中で: Giant trees shook from the vibrations, their branches slapping against our units' armor. I kept praying in my heart that it wouldn't notice the noise.
巨大な足音と振動はすでにしなくなっていたのだが、\nしばらくは誰も通信回路を開か: Although the massive footsteps and vibrations had already ceased, no one opened the comms channel for a while.
舞亜からの通信に胸にたまっていた息を吐きだす。: Hearing Maia's transmission, I finally exhaled the breath I had been holding.
原生帯〈プライマル・ベルト〉にはあんなのまでいるのか……: So the Primal Belt even has stuff like that...
あれはこの周辺にある未調査広間〈ホール〉の主といったところね。: That creature is essentially the lord of the unmapped Hall around this area.
とんでもないメイズシフターがいるんだねぇ。\n捕獲できたらよかったんだけど……: What an absurdly giant Maze Shifter～ It would've been awesome if we could capture it, though...
無理無理無理！ あんなデカいの絶対無理！: No way, no way, no way! Something that huge is absolutely impossible!
あれはＭＧでどうにかなるとは思えない……: I don't think an MG could ever handle something like that...
ああいう怪物には複数チームでないと対処できないからね。: Monsters like that can't be dealt with unless multiple teams work together.
それは複数チームならなんとかなるってことか？: Does that mean multiple teams could actually pull it off?
ええ、そういうミッションもあるもの。: Yes, there are missions like that.
でも、すっごく危ないのでやりたくないんですよねぇ……: But it's super dangerous, so I really don't want to do it...
１チームでの探索中に遭遇しちゃったら、\n気づかれないよう、興味を持たれないよう: If you encounter one while exploring as a single team, all you can do is pray that it doesn't notice you or take an interest.
もしも興味を持たれてしまったらどうすればいいのですか？: What should we do if it does take an interest in us?
あっけらかんと言う舞亜に全員が言葉を失っている。: Everyone was left speechless by Maia's completely nonchalant response.
確かに心臓が凍るような思いをした。\nだが決してそれだけではない。: It certainly felt like my heart froze in my chest. But that wasn't all.
捕獲ミッションとかがあれば参加したいねぇ。\nそのためにも腕を磨いておかないと。: If there's ever a capture mission, I'd love to join in～ We've gotta hone our skills for that, too.
誰かが気を引いてその隙に攻撃し続ければ、\nなんとかなるんじゃないでしょうか？: If someone draws its attention and we keep attacking during that opening, wouldn't we manage somehow?
他のメイズシフターが近寄ってくるかもしれないから、\n警戒はしっかりしておいたほ: Other Maze Shifters might come nearby, so I think we should stay on high alert.
あの巨体ならタツミヤ鉱を相当ため込んでるでしょ。\nリターンがすごいことになりそ: With a body that huge, it must have hoarded tons of Tatsumiya Ore. The payout would be insane!
他のチームとの連携訓練もできるようにしたいですわ。: I'd like to make sure we can practice joint-cooperation training with other teams as well.
……へー。こういう反応になるのね。: ...Huh. So this is how you'd react.
士気が崩壊して、尻尾を巻いて逃げると思ったか？: Did you think our morale would collapse and we'd run away with our tails between our legs?
いいえ、なんとなく、こうなるだろうなって思ってたわ。\nだってあなた達、葵に似て: No, I had a feeling it would turn out like this. After all, you guys resemble Aoi in some ways.
未知に対して興奮と好奇心を持てること。\nこれって強くなるパイロットの共通点だと: Being able to feel excitement and curiosity toward the unknown... I believe that's a trait shared by pilots who grow strong.
わたしはひたすら怖いだけですぅ……\nはやく帰りましょうよぉ～。: I'm just purely terrified... Let's go home already～
どうする？ このまま巣に向かうのか？: What should we do? Are we still heading toward the nest?
うーん、そうしたいところだけど、\n方角がさっきのメイズシフターの向かった先と同: Hmm, I'd like to, but that direction happens to be the same way that Maze Shifter just went.
あー……確かに。\n今回は諦めるしかなさそうだな。: Ah... that's true. Looks like we have no choice but to give up on it this time.
まあ、一応『原生帯〈プライマル・ベルト〉での立ち回りを教える』って\nところは満: Well, we satisfied the 'teaching you how to handle yourselves in the Primal Belt' part at least, so we can consider our main objective accomplished.
次からはシリウスシュガーだけで来ることになるんだけど、\nどうかしら？ やれそう: From next time onward, Sirius Sugar will be coming here on your own. How about it? Think you can handle it?
超巨大メイズシフターとどう対峙すべきかを\n熱心に話し合う仲間達を見ながら思う。: Looking at my teammates eagerly discussing how they ought to confront a super-gargantuan Maze Shifter, I think to myself.
それならよかったわ。じゃあ、撤収しましょうか。: Glad to hear it. Well then, shall we fall back?
こうしてシリウスシュガーの初めての原生帯〈プライマル・ベルト〉探索訓練は、\n興: And so, Sirius Sugar's very first training exploration in the Primal Belt came to an end amidst excitement and tension.
